enhancement_records.E-AUDIO-CONTINUOUS: Continuous low-information support bed throughout the timed session; no entry from digital silence.
enhancement_records.E-AUDIO-PRECUE: Familiar soft marker 0.4 seconds before every non-opening instruction, with bed ducking and voice fades.
enhancement_records.E-AUDIO-LOCAL: All voice and support audio packaged same-origin and offline-capable.
enhancement_records.E-BREATH-RAIL: Quiet five-in/five-out breath rail during the HeartMath phase; comfort override remains authoritative.
enhancement_records.E-VOICE-TEACH: Teach-tier wording, one operation per sentence, controlled rate and internal pauses.
enhancement_records.E-ATTN-RECOVERY: Source-compatible recovery instruction when attention becomes captured.
enhancement_records.E-TRANSITION: Operationally explicit transition between source methods; source metadata remains visible in the app.
enhancement_records.E-RETURN: Return begins at 24:00 and restores body, room, time, and next-action orientation.
enhancement_records.E-DEBRIEF: Immediate voice-first raw report before interpretation.
enhancement_records.E-BINAURAL-OPTION: Optional QCTP binaural support mode; not attributed to Day 1 teachers and no frequency profile is locked in A02.
enhancement_records.E-SAFETY: Comfort overrides cadence; no forced emotional excavation; no advanced-state claims.

breath_contract.route: not specified by source; do not force nasal-only
breath_contract.rail: quiet optional pacing support after first counted cycle

pre_session_orientation.spoken_text: You will hear a soft signal before each instruction. Set the voice and background to a comfortable level. The background continues for the whole practice. It is a QCTP support layer, not part of the teachers’ methods.
requirements: play selected bed for at least 3 seconds
confirm stereo headphones only when binaural mode selected

questions: What changed from the starting state?
What happened when you attempted appreciation, care, calm, or ease?
How did narrow attention differ from spatial attention?
What captured attention, and how did you recover?
What one quality will you carry into the next action?
